title: Atomic Units of X: The Compression Layer of Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2607.12634v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper proposes a theoretical and empirical framework for understanding intelligence as a process of atomic compression and compositional reuse. It argues that scalable cognitive, biological, computational, and organisational systems reduce complexity by organising information into reusable units that can be recombined into higher-order structures. The central contribution is the Compression Calculus, a formal framework for comparing surface evidence with atomic representations and for describing how abstraction can compound across layers. The framework is evaluated on large, multi-source software corpora under an open-world concept model, showing substantial evidence-to-concept consolidation in two large projects, while a smaller third project remains below the target threshold. translated_title: 智能的原子压缩层：X的原子单位
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个理论和实证框架，将智能理解为原子压缩和组合复用的过程。它认为，可扩展的认知、生物、计算和组织系统通过将信息组织成可复用的单元，并将其重组为更高阶的结构，从而降低复杂性。核心贡献是压缩演算，一个形式化框架，用于比较表面证据与原子表示，并描述抽象如何在各层之间复合。该框架在开放世界概念模型下对大型多源软件语料库进行了评估，在两个大型项目中显示出显著的证据到概念的整合，而较小的第三个项目仍低于目标阈值。分析进一步识别了重要的边界条件：整合取决于语料库规模、证据单元定义和概念同一性。
tldr: 本文提出了压缩演算框架，将智能视为原子压缩与组合复用的过程，并通过软件语料库实证验证了其有效性，同时揭示了整合的关键边界条件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Compression Calculus framework, conceptualizing intelligence as atomic compression and compositional reuse, validated on software corpora while identifying key boundary conditions for consolidation.
